children.label: c
children.prompt: Show that $\int_0^2\bigl((x-2)-(x^2-x-2)\bigr)\,dx=\int_0^2(2x-x^2)\,dx$. Evaluate and find the area.

answer.worked:
$$(x-2)-(x^2-x-2)=2x-x^2.$$
Hence the two integrals are equal.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=\int_0^2(2x-x^2)\,dx\\&=\left[x^2-\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^2\\&=4-\frac83\\&=\frac43\text{ u}^2\end{aligned}$$
